flows:
Navigate to http://localhost:4104 then book the free first visit class for Sam Rivera, email sam@example.com, on the second of November 2026 at noon.
Accept the waiver.
Then verify a booking confirmation with a reference code is shown.
Get the booking reference code from the booking confirmation and save as {{ref}}.

wait: PRIMARY: wait briefly on the booking confirmation after waiver acceptance
analyze: ANALYZE(textual_visual, 'the booking reference code from the booking confirmatio

summary:
Booked the free first-visit class for Sam Rivera using sam@example.com for November 2, 2026 at 12:00 PM.
Accepted the waiver.
The booking was confirmed and a reference code was shown and saved: PL-7302.
